source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 32 exercise hal (PDF 244-246): MCQs wajah ke saath, short, constructed aur descriptive jawab, Q3(a) qadam ba qadam, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 32 (Medicine, Agriculture and Industry) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab wajah ke saath diya gaya hai; short, constructed aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab hain, aur Q3(a) ka hisaab qadam ba qadam hai. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions (sahi jawab chunein)

blocks.prompt:
I) What does the TD₅₀ value in the TI formula represent?
(TI formula mein TD₅₀ kya zahir karta hai?)

options.text: Lowest dose that causes harm MTC.
Dose causing a toxic effect in 50 % of people.

blocks.explanation: TD₅₀ (Toxic Dose 50) woh dose hai jo lene walon mein se 50 % mein zehreela asar (toxic effect) karti hai; TI = TD₅₀ / ED₅₀ (32.1.2).

blocks.prompt:
II) What is the key structural feature for penicillin's antibiotic activity?
(Penicillin ki antibiotic kaarkardagi ki asal structural khasiyat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Penicillin mein chaar konon wali beta-lactam ring paanch konon wali thiazolidine ring se juri hai; beta-lactam ring is ki kaarkardagi ke liye laazmi hai (32.3.1).

blocks.prompt:
III) How do opiates like morphine reduce pain?
(Morphine jaise opiates dard kaise kam karte hain?)

options.text: They bind to opioid receptors, blocking pain signals.
They come from the opium poppy.
They build new cell walls in the brain.

blocks.explanation: Opiates dimagh aur spinal cord ke opioid receptors se (taala-chaabi ki tarah) jur kar dard ke signals ko dimagh tak pohanchne se rokte hain (32.3.2). (c) sach hai magar yeh in ka maakhaz (origin) hai, amal nahi.

blocks.prompt:
IV) Which N-P-K nutrient promotes protein synthesis and chlorophyll?
(N-P-K mein se kaun sa nutrient protein aur chlorophyll banane mein madad deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen amino acids (jin se proteins bante hain) aur chlorophyll ka bunyadi hissa hai (32.5).

blocks.prompt:
V) How does acid rain primarily damage soil?
(Acid rain mitti ko asal mein kaise nuqsan deti hai?)

options.text: It leaches essential nutrients and releases toxic Al³⁺.

blocks.explanation: Acid rain ke H⁺ Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺ aur K⁺ ko hata dete hain jo beh jaate hain (leaching), aur zehreele Al³⁺ ki hal pazeeri barhate hain jo jaron ko nuqsan deta hai (32.7). Acid rain mitti ka pH ghatati hai, barhati nahi.

blocks.prompt:
VI) What is a primary effect of climate change on agriculture?
(Climate change ka zaraat (agriculture) par bara asar kya hai?)

options.text: Reduced yields due to heat stress and erratic rainfall

blocks.explanation: Garmi ka dabao (heat stress) barhotri aur paidawar kam karta hai, aur barish ka badalta nizam khushk saali aur selaab la kar faslein tabah karta hai (32.8).

blocks.prompt:
VII) In Pakistan, rock salt (halite) is a key raw material for producing:
(Pakistan mein rock salt (halite) kis cheez ka ahem khaam maal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rock salt (NaCl, Khewra mines) soda ash, caustic soda (NaOH) aur chlorine ka khaam maal hai (32.10).

blocks.prompt:
VIII) Ammonia gas in industry is prepared by:
(Sanat mein ammonia gas kis process se banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Haber-Bosch process mein N₂ aur H₂ se iron catalyst ki madad se NH₃ banti hai: N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ (32.12). Contact process H₂SO₄ aur Solvay process Na₂CO₃ banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
XI) Plastics, synthetic fibres, and synthetic rubber are primary products of the:
(Plastics, synthetic fibres aur synthetic rubber kis sanat ki bunyadi paidawar hain?)
blocks.explanation: Petrochemical industry crude oil se plastics, synthetic rubber aur fibres banati hai (32.13).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Is sawal ka number “XI)” chhapa hai magar yeh VIII) ke baad hai; yeh sawal IX hai (agla X hai).

blocks.prompt:
X) What is the primary purpose of ventilation systems in a chemical facility?
(Chemical facility mein ventilation system ka asal maqsad kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Achha ventilation kaam ki jagah se zehreeli gases, dhuan (fumes) aur gard nikalta hai aur nuqsandeh cheezein saans mein jaane ka khatra kam karta hai (32.14).

blocks.prompt:
a) Write significance of Therapeutic Window and how it differs from Therapeutic Index.
Therapeutic window ki ahmiyat likhein aur yeh therapeutic index se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Therapeutic window mehfooz dose ki range batati hai: chauri window mehfooz aur lachakdar; tang window mein ehtiyat se dose aur khoon ki jaanch zaroori.

rows: Plasma concentrations ki woh range jo bina nuqsan ke asar kare
Drug ki hifazat ka miqdari (quantitative) paimana

blocks.prompt:
b) How structure of penicillin allows it to inhibit the transpeptidase enzyme?
Penicillin ka structure transpeptidase enzyme ko kaise rokta hai?
blocks.explanation: Penicillin ki shakal transpeptidase (bacteria ki cell wall mazboot karne wala enzyme) ke aam substrate jaisi hai, is liye enzyme ise utha leta hai. Phir is ki tani hui (strained) beta-lactam ring khul kar enzyme se hamesha ke liye jur jati hai aur use nakara kar deti hai; cell wall kamzor reh jati hai aur bacterium phat jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
c) What is the primary mechanism of action for opiate drugs, such as morphine, in providing analgesia (pain relief)?
Morphine jaisi opiate dawaon ka dard kam karne ka asal tareeqa kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Opiates dimagh aur spinal cord ke opioid (zyada tar μ) receptors se jurte hain. Is se calcium channels band aur potassium channels khul jaate hain, neuron hyperpolarize (zyada manfi charge wala) ho jata hai, aur dard ka signal dimagh tak nahi ja pata.

blocks.prompt:
d) Why is it significantly more challenging to develop safe and effective antiviral drugs compared to antibacterial drugs (antibiotics)?
Antiviral dawaein banana antibiotics se zyada mushkil kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Bacteria aazad jaandar hain jin ke apne nishane (maslan cell wall) hain, magar virus hamare cells ke andar reh kar hamari DNA/RNA machinery istemal karte hain, is liye unhein maarna hamare cells ko nuqsan deta hai. Virus tezi se mutation (badalte) karte hain aur hamare genome mein chhup (so) sakte hain jahan dawa nahi pohanchti.

blocks.prompt:
e) What is the concept of pesticide resistance in a target pest population, linking it to the principles of natural selection and repeated application?
Pest ki aabadi mein pesticide resistance kya hai? Natural selection aur baar baar spray se jor kar batayein.
blocks.explanation: Har spray kamzor (susceptible) keeron ko maar deta hai, magar qudrati muzahimat wale chand bach kar nasl barhate hain (natural selection). Baar baar spray se muzahimat wali qism barhti jati hai yahan tak ke pesticide be-asar ho jata hai, aur zyada zehreele pesticides istemal karne parte hain.

blocks.prompt:
f) Define soil salinization. How it can be caused by irrigation practices in regions experiencing higher temperatures and reduced precipitation.
Soil salinization ki tareef karein. Garam aur kam barish wale ilaqon mein irrigation is ka sabab kaise banti hai?
blocks.explanation: Soil salinization mitti mein, khaas kar ooper ki tah mein, hal hone wale namak (salts) ka jama hona hai (chapter se aage). Irrigation ke paani mein namak hal hota hai; zyada garmi paani urra deti hai aur namak peechhe reh jata hai, aur kam barish namak ko neeche nahi dhoti, is liye namak jama ho kar faslon ko nuqsan deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
g) How does the chemical industry contribute to both energy production from fossil fuels and the development of renewable energy technologies?
Chemical industry fossil fuels se energy aur renewable energy technologies dono mein kaise hissa leti hai?
blocks.explanation: Fossil fuels: refining (fractional distillation), cracking aur reforming crude oil aur natural gas ko gasoline, diesel, LPG jaise fuels mein badalte hain. Renewables: yeh materials banati hai, maslan solar panels ke liye silicon semiconductors aur energy jama karne ke liye batteries (maslan Li-ion).

blocks.prompt:
h) Name the industrial process used to produce caustic soda (NaOH) and chlorine (Cl₂) from the rock salt (NaCl).
Rock salt (NaCl) se caustic soda (NaOH) aur chlorine (Cl₂) banane wale process ka naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Chlor-alkali process: sodium chloride brine (namkeen paani) ki electrolysis, jis se chlorine (Cl₂), sodium hydroxide (NaOH) aur hydrogen (H₂) bante hain, aam tor par membrane cells mein.

blocks.prompt:
i) State two different types of products (other than fuels) that are derived from the petrochemical industry, linking them to their use in daily life.
Petrochemical industry ki do mukhtalif paidawar (fuel ke ilawa) aur rozmarra istemal batayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Plastics, maslan poly(ethene): thailiyan, botlein aur packing.
2. Synthetic rubber, maslan styrene-butadiene rubber: tyres aur jootay. (Polyester fibres kapron ke liye bhi.)

blocks.prompt:
j) Distinguish between a corrosive hazard and a toxic hazard, giving one example of a chemical for each.
Corrosive aur toxic hazard mein farq batayein aur har aik ki misal dein.
blocks.explanation: Dono sehat ke khatre hain; corrosive cheez chhoone par, toxic cheez jism ko zehar de kar nuqsan deti hai.

rows: Chhoone par jild, aankhon aur cheezon ko jala ya gala deta hai
Nigalne, saans ya jild se jazb hone par jism ko zehar deta hai
Aaza, aasaab, khoon waghera ko, aksar der tak

blocks.text: Q3. Constructed Response Questions (soch kar jawab)

blocks.prompt:
a) Drug A has an ED₅₀ of 20 mg and a TD₅₀ of 80 mg. Drug B has a Minimum Effective Concentration (MEC) of 5 mg/L and a Minimum Toxic Concentration (MTC) of 50 mg/dm³. Drug C has a therapeutic window where the effective dose is 10 mg and the toxic dose is 15 mg.
(i) Define Therapeutic Index (TI) and calculate the TI for Drug A.
(ii) Define Therapeutic Window (TW) and identify which drug (B or C) has the wider therapeutic window. Justify your answer.
(iii) Compare the relative safety of Drug A and Drug C.
Drug A: ED₅₀ 20 mg, TD₅₀ 80 mg; Drug B: MEC 5 mg/L, MTC 50 mg/dm³; Drug C: effective 10 mg, toxic 15 mg. (i) TI ki tareef aur Drug A ka TI; (ii) TW ki tareef aur B ya C mein chauri window; (iii) A aur C ki hifazat ka muqabla.
blocks.explanation:
(i) Therapeutic index (TI): drug ki hifazat ka miqdari paimana, jo zehreela asar karne wali dose ka matlooba asar wali dose se muqabla karta hai.
TI = TD₅₀ / ED₅₀
Given: TD₅₀ = 80 mg, ED₅₀ = 20 mg
TI = 80 mg / 20 mg = 4
(ii) Therapeutic window (TW): plasma mein drug concentrations ki woh range jo bina nuqsandeh side effects ke asar kare (MEC se MTC tak).
Drug B: MEC = 5 mg/L, MTC = 50 mg/dm³ = 50 mg/L (1 dm³ = 1 L)
Chaurai = 50 − 5 = 45 mg/L; MTC/MEC = 50/5 = 10
Drug C: effective 10 mg, toxic 15 mg
Chaurai = 15 − 10 = 5 mg; toxic/effective = 15/10 = 1.5
Drug B ki window chauri hai: is ka toxic level effective level ka 10 guna hai, jabke C ki toxic dose effective dose ki sirf 1.5 guna.
(iii) Drug A: TI = 4 (toxic dose effective dose ki 4 guna).
Drug C: toxic/effective = 15/10 = 1.5, bohat tang faasla.
Drug A Drug C se zyada mehfooz hai. Drug C ki window tang hai; is ki dose bohat ehtiyat se, khoon ki jaanch ke saath, deni hogi kyunke thora sa izafa bhi toxic level tak le jata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Drug B ki units mein mg/L aur mg/dm³ dono chhape hain; yeh aik hi hain (1 dm³ = 1 L), is liye seedha muqabla ho sakta hai. B (concentration) aur C (dose) ki units mukhtalif hain, is liye muqabla nisbat (toxic/effective) se karna behtar hai.

blocks.prompt:
b) (i) Contrast synthetic and organic fertilizers based on their origin.
(ii) Identify the three primary macronutrients (N, P, K) and describe the specific biological function of each in a plant.
(i) Synthetic aur organic fertilizers ka maakhaz ke lihaz se farq. (ii) Teen primary macronutrients (N, P, K) aur har aik ka paude mein kaam.
blocks.explanation:
(i) Table dekhein.
(ii) Nitrogen (N): amino acids (jin se proteins bante hain) aur chlorophyll (photosynthesis ka rang) ka bunyadi hissa; aksar fasal ki paidawar ko sab se zyada mehdood karne wala.
Phosphorus (P): ATP (adenosine triphosphate) ka structural hissa, jo energy jama aur kharij karta hai; superphosphates ya ammonium phosphates ki shakal mein diya jata hai.
Potassium (K): paude ke dhaanche ka hissa nahi banta; osmoregulator (paani aur namak ka tawazun rakhne wala) hai aur metabolism ke 60 se zyada enzymes ko activate karta hai.

rows: Chemical processes se insaan ke banaye hue

blocks.prompt:
c) Describe the chemical pathway from Natural Gas (CH₄) to urea fertilizer. Your answer must identify the crucial intermediate compound that is synthesized from CH₄ and air.
Natural gas (CH₄) se urea fertilizer tak ka chemical raasta bayan karein aur CH₄ aur hawa se banne wale ahem darmiyani compound ki nishandahi karein.
blocks.explanation:
Khaam maal: natural gas (CH₄) hydrogen ka zariya, aur hawa nitrogen ka zariya.
1. Methane se hydrogen (steam reforming, chapter se aage): CH₄ + H₂O → (Ni catalyst, garmi) CO + 3H₂; phir CO + H₂O → CO₂ + H₂ (is se baad mein chahiye CO₂ bhi milti hai).
2. Haber-Bosch process: hawa ki nitrogen is hydrogen se iron catalyst par milti hai:
N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃
Ammonia (NH₃) CH₄ aur hawa se banne wala ahem darmiyani (intermediate) compound hai.
3. Urea banana (chapter se aage): ammonia carbon dioxide se pressure aur garmi mein react karti hai:
2NH₃ + CO₂ → NH₂CONH₂ + H₂O
Pakistan ke bare plants (maslan Engro Fertilizers, FFC) natural gas se ammonia bana kar urea mein badalte hain; maqami gas ki wajah se khaad kisano ke liye sasti rehti hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q4. Describe the structure and mechanism of action of penicillin.
Penicillin ka structure aur amal ka tareeqa bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Penicillin taqatwar antibiotic hai jo bacterial infections, maslan strep throat, pneumonia, scarlet fever, sinusitis aur jild ke infections (cellulitis, erysipelas) mein di jati hai.
Structure:
1. Do bunyadi rings: chaar konon wali beta-lactam ring (C, C, N aur aik C=O carbon, yani cyclic amide) paanch konon wali thiazolidine ring (S aur N wali) se juri hui.
2. Thiazolidine ring par do methyl groups aur aik –COOH (carboxylic acid) group.
3. Beta-lactam ring par –NH–CO–R side chain; mukhtalif R groups se mukhtalif penicillins bante hain.
4. Chaar konon wali beta-lactam ring tani hui (strained) aur reactive hai; antibiotic ki kaarkardagi isi par hai (bacteria ke beta-lactamase enzymes bhi isi par hamla kar ke penicillin ko nakara karte hain).
Amal ka tareeqa:
1. Bacteria apni cell wall aik enzyme (transpeptidase) ki madad se banate hain jo wall ko jorta aur mazboot karta hai.
2. Penicillin enzyme ke aam substrate jaisi hai, is liye enzyme ghalti se penicillin molecule utha leta hai.
3. Beta-lactam ring khul kar enzyme se hamesha ke liye jur jati hai aur enzyme nakara ho jata hai.
4. Bacteria barhte rehte hain magar kaam karne wali cell wall ke baghair, is liye aakhir phat kar mar jaate hain.
5. Insaani cells mein cell wall nahi hoti, is liye penicillin hamare cells ko nuqsan nahi deti.

blocks.prompt:
Q5. What is Genetic Engineering? Give its main benefits and risks.
Genetic engineering kya hai? Is ke bare faide aur khatre batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Zaraat mein genetic engineering kisi jaandar ke DNA mein khaas genes jor kar, nikal kar ya badal kar matlooba khasiyat wali genetically modified (GM) faslein banana hai.
Marahil (Figure 32.4):
1. Pehchan: matlooba khasiyat wala mufeed gene dhoonda jata hai (maslan bacterium se keeron ke khilaf muzahimat, khushk saali bardasht).
2. Alag karna: gene ko jaandar se kaat kar alag kiya jata hai.
3. Daakhil karna: gene gun ya carrier bacterium (vector) se gene ko paude ke genome mein dala jata hai.
4. Izhar (expression): paude ke cells naya gene parh kar naya protein banate hain aur nayi khasiyat aa jati hai.
Faide:
1. Keeron aur bimariyon ke khilaf behtar muzahimat, maslan BT-cotton apna pesticide khud banati hai, spray kam.
2. Herbicides, khushk saali ya selaab bardasht karna.
3. Ghizaiyat mein izafa, maslan Golden Rice mein beta-carotene, andhe pan se bachao.
4. Zyada paidawar aur kam pesticide.
Khatre:
1. Outcrossing: GM genes jangli paudon mein phail sakte hain.
2. "Superweeds": herbicide-resistant genes cross-pollination se jhaariyon (weeds) mein ja kar unhein na-qabil-e-khatm bana sakte hain.
3. Muzahimat wale keere paida hona.
4. Insaani sehat aur biodiversity par lambe arse ke asraat ghair yaqeeni.

blocks.prompt:
Q6. Explain the role of industrial chemistry in economy of Pakistan. Also account the main raw materials available in Pakistan for these industries.
Pakistan ki maeeshat mein industrial chemistry ka kirdar bayan karein aur in sanaton ke liye Pakistan mein dastiyab khaam maal batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Maeeshat mein kirdar:
1. Chemical industry Pakistan ke GDP mein numayan hissa daalti aur rozgar deti hai.
2. Doosre bare shoabon ko sahara deti hai: zaraat (fertilizers), tameeraat (cement) aur textiles (dyes aur synthetic fibres).
3. Maqami khaam maal istemal karti hai, jis se imports par inhisar kam hota hai.
4. Ghizai tahaffuz: zaraati mulk hone ki wajah se Pakistan fertilizers par munhasir hai; maqami companies natural gas se urea banati hain, jis se import bill arbon dollars kam hota hai.
5. Textiles (50 % se zyada exports) cotton ki mercerizing ke liye caustic soda, rang aur pakkepan ke liye synthetic dyes, aur bleaching ke liye hydrogen peroxide istemal karti hain.
6. Cement industry, infrastructure aur shehri phailao ki wajah se, hamsaya ilaqon ko bari export karne wali ban gayi hai.
Ahem khaam maal:
1. Hawa: fertilizers ke liye nitrogen, steel ke liye oxygen; paani: solvent, thanda karne wala, hydrogen ka zariya.
2. Natural gas: urea aur petrochemicals ke liye methane; fuel aur hydrogen ka zariya.
3. Rock salt (Khewra mines, duniya ke sab se bare zakhairon mein se): soda ash, caustic soda aur chlorine ke liye NaCl.
4. Limestone (Salt Range aur Sindh): cement ke liye CaCO₃.
5. Gypsum: cement, plaster, mitti behtar karne wala, calcium aur sulphur ka zariya.
6. Chromite (Muslim Bagh): stainless steel aur pigments.
7. Crude oil: fuels aur petrochemicals.
8. Sulphur: sulphuric acid.
9. Coal, oil aur gas taqreeban 90 % organic chemicals ke hydrocarbons bhi dete hain.

blocks.prompt:
Q7. Write a note on various industrial chemical processes. Also account for the applications of these chemical industries in Pakistan.
Mukhtalif industrial chemical processes par note likhein aur Pakistan mein in sanaton ke istemal batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Chemical manufacturing do sutoon par khari hai: reaction engineering aur separation technology. Ahem processes:
1. Polymerisation: monomers jur kar polymers bante hain. Addition polymerisation: monomers bina atom khoye jurte hain (ethene → polyethene). Condensation polymerisation: monomers jurte hue chhota molecule, aksar paani, nikalte hain (maslan polyesters). Engro Polymer and Chemicals Pakistan mein PVC ka wahid producer hai.
2. Refining aur reforming: fractional distillation crude oil ko boiling point ke mutabiq gasoline, kerosene, diesel waghera mein alag karti hai; catalytic reforming seedhi chains ko branched/aromatic high-octane gasoline banati hai. PARCO aur Attock Refinery petrochemical feedstock bhi deti hain.
3. Haber-Bosch process: N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ iron catalyst par; zyada tar ammonia fertilizers mein jati hai. Engro Fertilizers aur FFC natural gas se ammonia aur phir urea banate hain.
4. Contact process: SO₂ → SO₃ (V₂O₅ ya Pt catalyst) → oleum → khalis, gaarha H₂SO₄, "King of Chemicals"; maslan Nimir Industrial Chemicals.
5. Solvay process: brine + ammonia + CO₂ → NaHCO₃, garam karne par Na₂CO₃ (soda ash); ammonia lime se wapas milti hai; by-product CaCl₂. Lucky Core Industries (pehle ICI) glass, detergents aur kaghaz ke liye soda ash banati hai.
6. Chlor-alkali process: NaCl brine ki electrolysis se Cl₂, NaOH aur H₂, jo plastics, detergents aur paani saaf karne mein lagte hain; maslan Sitara Chemical Industries aur Ittehad Chemicals, jo textiles aur water treatment ko sahara dete hain.
Pakistan mein istemal:
1. Petrochemical industry: crude oil ki cracking se plastics, synthetic rubber, fibres, lubricants aur waxes.
2. Cosmetics industry: sabun ke liye surfactants, creams ke liye emulsifiers, preservatives; jild ke liye pH-balanced products.
3. Cement industry: limestone aur clay rotary kiln mein 1500 °C par, phir gypsum ke saath peesna; bari export.
4. Food industry: preservatives (sodium benzoate), oils ki hydrogenation se margarine, baking soda (leavening agent), fortification (namak mein iodine, tail mein vitamin A).
5. Fertilizer aur textile sanatein urea, caustic soda, dyes aur H₂O₂ par chalti hain.

blocks.prompt:
Q8. What are important safety measures which must be followed while working in different chemical industries? Make a checklist to verify their adoption.
Chemical sanaton mein kaam karte hue zaroori hifazati iqdamat kya hain? In par amal jaanchne ke liye checklist banayein.
blocks.explanation:
Hifazati iqdamat:
1. Zaati hifazati saaman (PPE): chemicals, garmi aur dhuen se bachne ke liye dastane, chashme (goggles), helmet, lab coat aur hifazati jootay.
2. Durust label, istemal aur zakheera: aag pakarne wale, zehreele aur corrosive (galane wale) chemicals munasib bartanon mein aur alag store mein, taake risaao, girna, milawat ya khatarnak reaction na ho (maslan concentrated HNO₃ jaise oxidizers ethanol jaise aag pakarne walon se door).
3. Aag, chemicals girne, gas leak aur dhamakon ke liye emergency plan; emergency exits, aag bujhane ke aalaat, first-aid kits aur spill-control saaman; kaarkun jaante hon ke kya karna hai.
4. Achha ventilation taake zehreeli gases, dhuan aur gard nikal jaye.
5. Kaarkunon ki khatarnak cheezein aur machines chalane ki training.
6. Machines, pipelines aur tanks ki baqaida jaanch aur marammat taake kharabi jaldi pakri jaye.
Checklist (Haan/Nahi):
☐ Har kaarkun kaam ke mutabiq PPE pehne hue hai.
☐ Tamam bartanon par label hain; aapas mein khatarnak chemicals alag rakhe hain.
☐ Likha hua emergency plan hai aur mashq (drills) hoti hai.
☐ Emergency exits nishan zada aur khule hain.
☐ Aag bujhane ke aalaat, first-aid aur spill kits mojood aur muddat ke andar hain.
☐ Ventilation/exhaust nizam chal raha hai.
☐ Sab kaarkunon ki safety training ho chuki hai, record ke saath.
☐ Machines, pipelines aur tanks ki jaanch aur marammat waqt par, log ke saath.
